en.html:
We joined the Ootori pair and started home.
When I left, no rain. Now the entire space between earth and sky was occupied. I had to borrow an umbrella at Hachimangu.

Nagakura's preparedness possessed no restraint whatsoever. From somewhere, umbrellas appeared. The old woman and the young one had their own.
Kanae's was plain white.

She kept turning it round and round in her hand. Perhaps she liked it.
Her mood seemed quite good.

ja.html:
大鳥主従と合流し、帰路につく。
　出がけには無かった雨が天地の狭間を満たしており、
俺は八幡宮で傘を借りねばならなかった。

　野放図なまでに用意のいい永倉侍従が何処からとも
なく取り出したので、老若の女性二人組は自前の傘を
差している。
　香奈枝嬢のそれは、白の無地。

　気に入りなのか、手の中で弄んでくるくると回して
いる。
　機嫌が良さそうだった。

Sayo"True, madam. A blessing, people call it also."
Kanae"Exactly. ...Ufufufufufufufufu."
Sayo"W-what is happening, madam!? That laugh is devilish, suspicious, and no longer participating in humanity! This Sayo nearly threw a stone at you!"
Kanae"Ufu... agriculture does not have a monopoly on the blessings of rain—"
Kanae"A man and woman's love may benefit also!"

Sayo"Wah... a fearsome strategy! The entire sky has become your marriage broker. Naturally, this Sayo cannot be serving an ordinary thinker."
Kanae"Uffufufu..."
Sayo"But madam, an advantage is not an invitation. Do this deliberately, and the gentleman is facing two natural disasters. One rain, one you."
Kanae"Arre, without risk where is the courage? If I wait for a welcome before daring anything, what bravery have I shown? You are proving my point, Nanny. Love's fruit requires courage people will call madness!"
Kanae"Kageaki, you agree with me, no?"
Kageaki"Yes."
Kanae"Then this courage, all I can offer... you will accept?"
Kageaki"Yes."
Kanae"Nanny, you heard? At last, my feelings have reached the correct address...!"
Sayo"Congratulations, madam! Two yeses received. Zero words heard. A complete understanding, naturally."

en.html:
The conversation entered one ear and left by the other.
Inside, there was no room. Something else had occupied the place.

The Prince and the Chief. What they really intended.
They were not going to judge Kageaki Minato.

My evil would be allowed to pass. No examination under the law. No punishment to match.

Those two knew everything. If even they, outside parties, would not act, then that was what would happen.

...What nonsense.

Such a thing—
Such absolute nonsense could be permitted?

It could not...

上の空に聞く会話は、右から左へ流れ去るばかりだ。
　頭の中は既に別のもので占められている。

　知らされた、親王と署長の真意。
　――彼らは湊斗景明を裁くつもりがない。

　俺の犯した悪は見逃されてしまう。
　法に照らされ、相応しい報いを与えられることなく。

　全てを知る第三者たる彼らにその意思が無い以上は
必然、そうなる。
　
　……馬鹿な。

　そんな――馬鹿な事が。
　許されて良いのか。

　良い筈はない……。

Kageaki"..."
Kanae"...Come to think of it, Kageaki, you seem rather low. What has happened?"
Sayo"Really, madam? Gloomy face. A presence that makes the stock market fall if he walks too close... Minato sir seems perfectly normal."
Kanae"But after so much flirting from me, normally he would shout, 'Arre, stop circling the matter! My attention you want, na? Lo, here I am!' and charge over. Would he not?"
Sayo"Now that you mention it, the picture is forming."
Kanae"Perhaps something happened at Hachimangu."
Sayo"Something?"
Kanae"Something that would bring a gentleman so low..."
Sayo"Yes?"
Kanae"...Has common sense taken hold?"
Sayo"One moment."
Kanae"Reasonable. Permanently reasonable...?"
Sayo"I said WAIT, madam."
Kanae"At this age... Sayo, what do I do? 'Even with common sense, Kageaki, I still like you!' I want to tell him, but perhaps that will hurt him more?"
Sayo"And how, precisely, did Hachimangu discover this common sense?"
Kanae"................................"
Kanae"Oh..."
Sayo"Even humanity has stopped answering your calls, madam."
Kageaki"..."

en.html:
Even the rain sounded far away.
My wet leather shoes, however, were very much present. Clammy, irritating. Impossible to ignore.

The whole world could become distant, but not these two. Nahin, sahib, we are here. Whatever tragedy you are considering, kindly consider your socks also. Such devotion. My thoughts had left the road entirely, and my feet were still giving me a complete account of the weather.

Cold kept needling my skin, getting on my nerves...

en.html:
Kanae finished the conversation at some speed and went straight into the lane.
No chance to call her back.

I watched the white umbrella go and let out a breath.
Honestly, part of me was relieved.

Everything required effort now.
The climb to Zeniarai Benten did not even gain a few dozen meters in height. Even that felt too much.

Standing here in the rain until she came back was much easier. Preferable, even.
No thoughts required. No thinking to be done.

Nagakura stood silent, hardly letting her presence be felt. Maybe she understood my mood and was being considerate.
That troubled me also. But even that trouble, I did not want to think about.

...Why had Captain Ootori left her here?
She could have taken her along.

And just before going towards Genjiyama, had the two of them exchanged a look? It seemed so. That—

...Bas. Leave it.

Thinking itself was exhausting now.

ja.html:
やや早口に会話をまとめると、香奈枝嬢はさっさと
路地へ入っていってしまった。
　呼び止める間もない。

　白い傘を見送って、ふと息をつく。
　正直、安堵する部分もあった。

　今は何をするのも億劫だ。
　銭洗弁天までは標高にして何十メートルもないが、
それでも今の自分には荷が重い。

　彼女の帰りを雨の下に立ち尽くして待つ方がずっと
楽だった。むしろそれなら望むところだった。
　何も思わず、何も考えずにいられる。

　永倉侍従は黙して佇立し、ろくに気配さえ感じさせ
ない。こちらの心境を読み、気を遣ったのかもしれな
かった。それはそれで心苦しかったが――今はそんな
ことも考えたくはない。

　……しかし、なぜ大鳥大尉は侍従を残したのだろう。
　一緒に連れて行けば良さそうなものだが。

　そういえば源氏山へ向かう間際、二人で無言の視線
を交し合ったように見えたが――あれは――
　
　……やめよう。

　物を考えると、今は酷く疲れる……。

Sayo"Something happened, madam?"
Kanae"...No. Nothing very much."
Kanae"Only, I heard a rather unpleasant story..."
Sayo"At Benten?"
Kanae"Yes. The chief priest happened to be there, so I asked about the shrine's history. And—"
Sayo"He said, actually our god is an octopus-type fellow sleeping in a city at the bottom of the sea?"
Kanae"Extremely unpleasant, yes. But no. ...It was such an interesting shrine, with a cave for its entrance. I remarked that it must be a fine place for children to play."
Kanae"His face darkened. Until recently, he said, a lively group of four had often visited. But not any longer..."
Sayo"What...?"
Kanae"...All four met with misfortune, he said. One vanished in a bamboo grove near here. Nothing since."

en.html:
Why.
Why.

Why was I the one still alive?
Killed and killed and killed and killed. Sent so many people to a world with no rain. But I could still walk here, rain falling on me. Why was that allowed?

Wrong.
Unreasonable.
Unjust.

Not permissible.
I had to be punished.

And yet—forgiveness was being arranged.

The people who knew my crimes would not denounce them. Forgive them. Praise them as achievements, even. Give me rest.

Kyun?

Why should such an injustice be allowed to pass!

どうして。
　どうして。

　どうして俺だけが生きているのだ。
　殺して殺して殺して殺して、何人もの人を雨もない
世界へ追いやったくせに、どうして俺だけは今も雨を
浴びて歩くことを許されているのだ。

　おかしい。
　理不尽だ。
　不条理だ。

　許されない。
　俺は罰せられなければならない。

　――だというのに、許されようとしている。

　俺の罪を知る者が、俺の罪を鳴らそうとしない。
　許し……あまつさえ功績と称え……安息を与えよう
などと云う。

　どうして。
　
　どうして――そんな理不尽が通る！
